pub mod blob_service {
    pub const PROGRAM: u32 = 200001;

    pub mod blob_service_v1 {
        pub const VERSION: u32 = 1;
        pub const BLOB_NULL: u32 = 0;
        pub const BLOB_COPY: u32 = 1;

        pub struct BLOB_SERVICE_V1Client<T> {
            client: onc_rpc_runtime::Client<T>,
        }

        impl<T> BLOB_SERVICE_V1Client<T> where T: onc_rpc_runtime::ClientTransport {
            pub fn new(client: onc_rpc_runtime::Client<T>) -> Self {
                Self { client }
            }

            pub fn blob_null(&self) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_runtime::RuntimeError> {
                self.client.call_typed(
                    onc_rpc_runtime::ProgramVersion { program: super::PROGRAM, version: VERSION },
                    onc_rpc_runtime::Procedure(BLOB_NULL),
                    &(),
                )
            }

            pub fn blob_copy(&self, argument: crate::blob_service_basic::copy_request_t) -> Result<crate::transfer_types::job_result_t, onc_rpc_runtime::RuntimeError> {
                self.client.call_typed(
                    onc_rpc_runtime::ProgramVersion { program: super::PROGRAM, version: VERSION },
                    onc_rpc_runtime::Procedure(BLOB_COPY),
                    &argument,
                )
            }

        }

        pub trait BLOB_SERVICE_V1Service {
            fn blob_null(&self) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_server::DispatchError>;
            fn blob_copy(&self, argument: crate::blob_service_basic::copy_request_t) -> Result<crate::transfer_types::job_result_t, onc_rpc_server::DispatchError>;
        }

        pub struct BLOB_SERVICE_V1Dispatch<T> {
            inner: T,
        }

        impl<T> BLOB_SERVICE_V1Dispatch<T> {
            pub fn new(inner: T) -> Self {
                Self { inner }
            }
        }

        impl<T> onc_rpc_server::Dispatch for BLOB_SERVICE_V1Dispatch<T> where T: BLOB_SERVICE_V1Service + Send + Sync + 'static {
            fn dispatch(&self, request: onc_rpc_server::RequestContext) -> Result<onc_rpc_server::ResponsePayload, onc_rpc_server::DispatchError> {
                match request.procedure.0 {
                    0 => {
                        <() as onc_rpc_xdr::XdrDecode>::from_xdr_bytes(&request.payload).map_err(|_| onc_rpc_server::DispatchError::GarbageArgs)?;
                        self.inner.blob_null()?;
                        let payload = onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncode::to_xdr_bytes(&()).map_err(|_| onc_rpc_server::DispatchError::SystemError)?;
                        Ok(onc_rpc_server::ResponsePayload::success(payload))
                    }
                    1 => {
                        let argument = <crate::blob_service_basic::copy_request_t as onc_rpc_xdr::XdrDecode>::from_xdr_bytes(&request.payload).map_err(|_| onc_rpc_server::DispatchError::GarbageArgs)?;
                        let response = self.inner.blob_copy(argument)?;
                        let payload = onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncode::to_xdr_bytes(&response).map_err(|_| onc_rpc_server::DispatchError::SystemError)?;
                        Ok(onc_rpc_server::ResponsePayload::success(payload))
                    }
                    _ => Err(onc_rpc_server::DispatchError::ProcedureUnavailable),
                }
            }
        }

    }

}
